# S3 Explorer

> Self-hosted, multi-user web console for any S3-compatible object storage (AWS S3, MinIO, R2, B2, Wasabi, ...), with client-side encrypted credentials, TOTP two-factor auth, dual-pane browsing, versioning, search, and cross-provider transfers.

S3 Explorer is a Node 20 + TypeScript + Express application with a framework-less vanilla TypeScript SPA and SQLite for accounts and search indexing. The server never stores S3 keys: users keep credentials in a browser-side encrypted vault and each API request carries them as transient headers. It ships as a two-container Docker Compose stack (app + Caddy with automatic TLS).

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): Features, quick start (Docker Compose or plain Node), configuration reference, and minimum IAM policy.
- [docs/api.md](docs/api.md): HTTP API reference — auth flow, session model, and every `/auth/*` and `/api/*` endpoint with parameters and error shape.
- [docs/mcp.md](docs/mcp.md): MCP server — lets AI agents operate S3-compatible storage through the S3 Explorer API; setup for Claude Code / Claude Desktop, environment variables, tool reference, and security notes.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Contributor guide for AI agents and humans — dev setup, build/test commands, architecture map, code conventions, and security invariants that must not be weakened.
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): Security policy, threat model, deployment hardening checklist, and vulnerability reporting.
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): Release history.
